sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bilbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Tonight, when Joe Biden formally accepts the Democratic Party's nomination for president, it will be the culmination of a 30-year quest and two failed runs for the office.
sentences.zh: 今晚，当乔·拜登正式接受民主党总统候选人提名时，这将是他30年追求和两次竞选失败后的巅峰时刻。

sentences.en: My colleague, Matt Flegenheimer, on a delayed victory that looks nothing like Biden had planned.
sentences.zh: 我的同事马特·弗莱根海默将讲述这场迟来的胜利，它看起来与拜登最初的计划截然不同。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月20日，星期四。

sentences.en: America needs someone who can inspire once again in our people faith and trust in our government.
sentences.zh: 美国需要一个能再次激发人民对政府信心和信任的人。

sentences.en: America needs someone with a heart.
sentences.zh: 美国需要一个有心的人。

sentences.en: Matt, take us back to when Joe Biden first runs for president.
sentences.zh: 马特，带我们回到乔·拜登第一次竞选总统的时候。

sentences.en: Where does that story start?
sentences.zh: 那个故事是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: That story starts at a train station in Wilmington, Delaware, in June of 1987.
sentences.zh: 那个故事始于1987年6月特拉华州威尔明顿的一个火车站。

sentences.en: And we thank you, Delaware, for giving us that person, the next president of the United States, Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 我们感谢特拉华州，感谢你们把这个人，下一任美国总统乔·拜登，交给我们。

sentences.en: He's coming in the end of the second term for Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: 他是在罗纳德·里根第二个任期即将结束时出现的。

sentences.en: All right, ladies and gentlemen.
sentences.zh: 好了，女士们，先生们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: He is in his 40s and...
sentences.zh: 他当时40多岁，而且……

sentences.en: I tell you today that America is a nation at risk.
sentences.zh: 我今天告诉你们，美国是一个处于危险之中的国家。

sentences.en: He is kind of the generational change candidate.
sentences.zh: 他算是一位代表代际变革的候选人。

sentences.en: The clarion call for my generation is not, it is our turn, but rather, it is our moment of obligation and opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我们这一代人的号角不是“轮到我们了”，而是“这是我们承担义务和把握机遇的时刻”。

sentences.en: And he uses the words my generation quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 他经常使用“我们这一代人”这个词。

sentences.en: This idea that after Reagan, after a lot of stodgy older men...
sentences.zh: 这种想法是，在里根之后，在许多古板的老年男性之后……

sentences.en: We literally have a chance to shape the future, to put our stamp on the face and character of America.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有机会塑造未来，在世界的面貌和美国的性格上留下我们的印记。

sentences.en: This is not merely history.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是历史。

sentences.en: It is our destiny.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的命运。

sentences.en: That it was time for a kind of breath of fresh air, and he was somebody who was going to bring that.
sentences.zh: 当时需要一股新鲜空气，而他就是那个能带来新鲜空气的人。

sentences.en: We need a new kind of presidential leadership.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一种新的总统领导力。

sentences.en: A presidential leadership that's prepared to tell the hard truths and lead this country.
sentences.zh: 一种准备好说出残酷真相并领导这个国家的总统领导力。

sentences.en: There's not a signature proposal he's running on.
sentences.zh: 他并没有提出什么标志性的竞选纲领。

sentences.en: He's really not a 12-point plan kind of candidate.
sentences.zh: 他真的不是那种靠“12点计划”竞选的候选人。

sentences.en: That sounds like a pretty vague pitch to be making to voters.
sentences.zh: 这对选民来说听起来是一个相当模糊的卖点。

sentences.en: It is kind of vague.
sentences.zh: 确实有点模糊。

sentences.en: And he really struggled with articulating a rationale beyond wanting to be president.
sentences.zh: 而且他确实很难阐述除了想当总统之外的理由。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, there's much more to say, but I don't want to trespass on my time.
sentences.zh: 女士们，先生们，还有很多话要说，但我不想占用太多时间。

sentences.en: It was not always clear exactly why he was running.
sentences.zh: 他为什么要参选，这一点并不总是很明确。

sentences.en: Government can do many things, but in the final analysis, government can act little more than as a catalySt.
sentences.zh: 政府可以做很多事情，但归根结底，政府的作用不过是催化剂。

sentences.en: We must demand more of ourselves, for nothing will suffice short of the wholesale commitment of an entire society.
sentences.zh: 我们必须对自己提出更高的要求，因为只有整个社会全力以赴才足够。

sentences.en: And why do you think he was running?
sentences.zh: 你认为他为什么要参选？

sentences.en: I think he wanted to be president.
sentences.zh: 我认为他想当总统。

sentences.en: He is somebody who, by his own account, talked about that in grade school.
sentences.zh: 据他自己说，他在小学时就谈论过这件事。

sentences.en: He's somebody who was elected to the Senate at 29, took office shortly thereafter when he turned 30.
sentences.zh: 他29岁当选参议员，30岁时就正式就职了。

sentences.en: And this is a dream he had chased in some measure from the moment that he entered public office.
sentences.zh: 这是他从进入公职那一刻起，在某种程度上一直追逐的梦想。

sentences.en: At the same time, he also looked around at the field in 88 and was unimpressed.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他也环顾了88年的竞选阵营，觉得印象平平。

sentences.en: They were sort of known derisively.
sentences.zh: 他们当时被嘲讽地称为……

sentences.en: The field at that point on the Democratic side as the Seven Dwarfs was sort of the put-down in the press.
sentences.zh: 当时民主党阵营被称为“七个小矮人”，这是媒体对他们的贬称。

sentences.en: And he looked at that group and said, why not Joe Biden?
sentences.zh: 他看着那群人说，为什么不是乔·拜登呢？

sentences.en: And when he enters this race, who is Joe Biden in this moment?
sentences.zh: 当他参加这场竞选时，当时的乔·拜登是谁？

sentences.en: What is he actually known for, given his career up to that moment?
sentences.zh: 考虑到他当时的职业生涯，他实际上以什么闻名？

sentences.en: So despite having been in the Senate at this point for going on three terms just about, he's really still known nationally best for being a kind of tragic figure.
sentences.zh: 尽管当时他已经在参议院待了快三届了，但他全国闻名的身份其实是一个悲剧性人物。

sentences.en: He was elected to the Senate in 1972.
sentences.zh: 他于1972年当选参议员。

sentences.en: The following month, his wife and daughter were killed in a car crash.
sentences.zh: 次月，他的妻子和女儿在车祸中丧生。

sentences.en: His two sons were injured.
sentences.zh: 他的两个儿子受了伤。

sentences.en: And he was immediately sort of identified in the public consciousness as a figure of tremendous sympathy and as someone who had been left to mourn in public by tint of his profession.
sentences.zh: 他立刻在公众意识中被视为一个极具同情心的人物，一个因为职业原因被迫在公众面前哀悼的人。

sentences.en: So his early career in Congress is very much defined by this personal tragedy, as much as any legislative accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 因此，他早期的国会生涯很大程度上是由这场个人悲剧定义的，其程度不亚于任何立法成就。

sentences.en: That's certainly true.
sentences.zh: 这当然是真的。

sentences.en: So how does this campaign in 87, how does it go?
sentences.zh: 那么87年的这场竞选进展如何？

sentences.en: It goes fine for a while.
sentences.zh: 起初进展顺利。

sentences.en: He is somebody who was doing very well in fundraising early on.
sentences.zh: 他早期在筹款方面做得非常好。

sentences.en: He was drawing crowds even before he entered the race in some of the early states he was visiting.
sentences.zh: 甚至在他正式参选之前，他在访问一些早期州时就已经吸引了人群。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of figures within the party saw him as very formidable.
sentences.zh: 我认为党内许多人都认为他非常强大。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Now to the controversy that has suddenly erupted around the Democratic presidential candidate, Joseph Biden.
sentences.zh: 现在转向围绕民主党总统候选人约瑟夫·拜登突然爆发的争议。

sentences.en: He gets himself into trouble.
sentences.zh: 他给自己惹上了麻烦。

sentences.en: The charge that he has plagiarized parts of his speeches.
sentences.zh: 指控称他抄袭了部分演讲稿。

sentences.en: On a couple of occasions, he's accused of lifting the words of others.
sentences.zh: 有几次，他被指控剽窃他人的言论。

sentences.en: And I started thinking as I was coming over here, why is it that Joe Biden is the first in his family ever to go to a university?
sentences.zh: 我走过来的时候开始想，为什么乔·拜登是家里第一个上大学的人？

sentences.en: Why is it that my wife, who's sitting out there in the audience, is the first in her family to ever go to college?
sentences.zh: 为什么坐在观众席里的我的妻子，是她家里第一个上大学的人？

sentences.en: The most memorable is at a debate in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 最令人难忘的是在爱荷华州的一场辩论中。

sentences.en: Is it because our fathers and mothers were not bright?
sentences.zh: 是因为我们的父母不够聪明吗？

sentences.en: Is it because I'm the first Biden in a thousand generations to get a college and a graduate degree that I was smarter than the rest?
sentences.zh: 是因为我是千百代以来第一个获得大学和研究生学位的拜登，所以我就比其他人更聪明吗？

sentences.en: At Iowa, he is caught using the words of Neil Kinnick, who's a British politician.
sentences.zh: 在爱荷华州，他被抓到使用了英国政治家尼尔·基诺克的言论。

sentences.en: Why am I the first Kinnick in a thousand generations to be able to get the university?
sentences.zh: 为什么我是千百代以来第一个能上大学的基诺克？

sentences.en: Why is Glennis the first woman in her family in a thousand generations to be able to get the university?
sentences.zh: 为什么格伦尼斯是她家里千百代以来第一个能上大学的女性？

sentences.en: Was it because all our predecessors were thick?
sentences.zh: 是因为我们所有的祖先都很笨吗？

sentences.en: And passing them off as his own.
sentences.zh: 并把这些话当作自己的话。

sentences.en: Is it because they didn't work hard?
sentences.zh: 是因为他们工作不够努力吗？

sentences.en: My ancestors who worked in the coal mines in northeast Pennsylvania and who'd come up after 12 hours and play football for four hours?
sentences.zh: 我的祖先在宾夕法尼亚州东北部的煤矿工作，工作12小时后上来还要踢4小时足球？

sentences.en: Was it because they were weak?
sentences.zh: 是因为他们软弱吗？

sentences.en: Those people who could work eight hours underground and then come up and play football?
sentences.zh: 那些能在地下工作8小时，上来还能踢足球的人？

sentences.en: He's quoted Kinnick before on the trail and cited him appropriately.
sentences.zh: 他在竞选路上之前引用过基诺克，并适当地注明了出处。

sentences.en: In this instance, he just says the words as if they are extemporaneous Joe Biden words.
sentences.zh: 但在这次实例中，他只是说了这些话，就好像这是乔·拜登即兴发挥的一样。

sentences.en: Does not mention Kinnick.
sentences.zh: 没有提到基诺克。

sentences.en: No citation.
sentences.zh: 没有注明出处。

sentences.en: No, it's not because they weren't as smart.
sentences.zh: 不，不是因为他们不够聪明。

sentences.en: It's not because they didn't work as hard.
sentences.zh: 不是因为他们工作不够努力。

sentences.en: It's because they didn't have a platform upon which to stand.
sentences.zh: 是因为他们没有一个可以立足的平台。

sentences.en: It was because there was no platform upon which they could stand.
sentences.zh: 是因为他们没有可以立足的平台。

sentences.en: And then it gets picked up in the press.
sentences.zh: 然后媒体开始报道这件事。

sentences.en: Biden seemed to be claiming Kinnick's vision and life as his own.
sentences.zh: 拜登似乎在声称基诺克的愿景和生活是他自己的。

sentences.en: I should have said to paraphrase Neil Kinnick.
sentences.zh: 我本应该说，借用尼尔·基诺克的话。

sentences.en: The problem here is that Senator Biden told his audience he'd just been thinking about these things and he failed to give any credit at all to his famous British speechwriter.
sentences.zh: 这里的问题是，拜登参议员告诉听众，他只是在思考这些事情，但他完全没有提到他那位著名的英国演讲稿撰写人。

sentences.en: So this moment begets other moments, unpleasant moments for Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 所以这个时刻引发了其他时刻，对乔·拜登来说不愉快的时刻。

sentences.en: CBS News found a tape of a second instance.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻发现了一段关于第二次实例的录音。

sentences.en: Biden had appropriated a famous litany from the late Robert Kennedy about what the gross national product cannot measure.
sentences.zh: 拜登挪用了已故罗伯特·肯尼迪关于国民生产总值无法衡量什么的著名排比句。

sentences.en: It cannot measure the health of our children.
sentences.zh: 它无法衡量我们孩子的健康。

sentences.en: The health of our children.
sentences.zh: 我们孩子的健康。

sentences.en: The quality of our education.
sentences.zh: 我们教育的质量。

sentences.en: The quality of their education.
sentences.zh: 他们教育的质量。

sentences.en: The joy of their play.
sentences.zh: 他们玩耍的快乐。

sentences.en: For the joy of their play.
sentences.zh: 他们玩耍的快乐。

sentences.en: There is a story on his record in law school.
sentences.zh: 关于他在法学院的记录有一个故事。

sentences.en: Joseph Biden admitted today that he committed plagiarism when he was in law school.
sentences.zh: 约瑟夫·拜登今天承认，他在法学院时曾有过剽窃行为。

sentences.en: He said it was a mistake, but that it was unintentional.
sentences.zh: 他说这是一个错误，但并非故意。

sentences.en: He quoted five pages of someone else's work without proper citation.
sentences.zh: 他引用了别人五页的作品而没有正确注明出处。

sentences.en: Then.
sentences.zh: 然后。

sentences.en: What law school did you attend and where did you place in that class?
sentences.zh: 你上了哪所法学院，在班里排名如何？

sentences.en: A video from the spring circulates of him.
sentences.zh: 春天的一段视频流传开来。

sentences.en: And the other question is, could you quickly.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是，你能快点吗。

sentences.en: I think I probably have a much higher IQ than you do.
sentences.zh: 我想我的智商可能比你高得多。

sentences.en: I suspect.
sentences.zh: 我怀疑。

sentences.en: Essentially telling a voter in New Hampshire who asked about his academic history, I probably have a much higher IQ than you do, I suspect.
sentences.zh: 本质上是告诉新罕布什尔州一位询问他学术背景的选民，我怀疑我的智商可能比你高得多。

sentences.en: I went to law school on a full academic scholarship.
sentences.zh: 我靠全额学术奖学金上了法学院。

sentences.en: The only one in my in my class to have a full academic scholarship.
sentences.zh: 我是班里唯一一个获得全额学术奖学金的人。

sentences.en: And he goes on to exaggerate his record in law school,
sentences.zh: 他继续夸大他在法学院的记录，

sentences.en: saying things like I was the only one in my class to get a full academic scholarship and other things that turned out not to be true.
sentences.zh: 说出诸如“我是班里唯一一个获得全额学术奖学金的人”之类的话，结果证明并非事实。

sentences.en: And that combination of both the exaggeration and the sort of belligerence with a member of the electorate did not sit well when that clip began circulating in wider fashion.
sentences.zh: 这种夸大其词和对选民的傲慢态度，在视频开始广泛流传时并没有产生好的影响。

sentences.en: And this sort of snowballs onto itself.
sentences.zh: 这就像滚雪球一样越滚越大。

sentences.en: If and when I've ever quoted anyone without saying this is their quote, it's either because, in fact, it's been clearly known by everyone what it is,
sentences.zh: 如果我曾经引用过某人的话而没有说明这是他们的引语，那要么是因为实际上大家都清楚这是谁的话，

sentences.en: or I honestly did not know I was quoting somebody else.
sentences.zh: 要么就是我真的不知道我在引用别人的话。

sentences.en: He has always been dogged by this idea.
sentences.zh: 他一直被这种想法所困扰。

sentences.en: And it's an insecurity he's talked about a lot himself, that he was not necessarily a policy heavyweight or a brilliant thinker.
sentences.zh: 这也是他自己经常谈论的一种不安全感，即他未必是一个政策重量级人物或杰出的思想家。

sentences.en: He didn't go to an Ivy League school.
sentences.zh: 他没有上过常春藤盟校。

sentences.en: And there was something of a chip on his shoulder as a result of this.
sentences.zh: 因此，他有一种怀才不遇的心理。

sentences.en: And he really thinks he's been disrespected in the national media, not taken seriously enough.
sentences.zh: 他真的认为自己在全国媒体中受到了不尊重，没有被足够认真地对待。

sentences.en: There's a cliche on Capitol Hill about workhorses and showhorses.
sentences.zh: 国会山有一个关于“干活马”和“表演马”的陈词滥调。

sentences.en: And the perception among a lot of people watching him is that he's a showhorse.
sentences.zh: 许多观察他的人认为他是一匹“表演马”。

sentences.en: I took the cases out of the Law Review article and the footnotes out of the Law Review article.
sentences.zh: 我从法律评论文章中摘录了案例，并从法律评论文章中摘录了脚注。

sentences.en: And I thought what I was doing, honestly, was the right way to do it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我以为我这样做是正确的方法。

sentences.en: So he holds a kind of stop the bleeding press conference at the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 所以他在国会大厦举行了一场“止血”新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Trying to essentially reset his campaign and stabilize himself as a candidate.
sentences.zh: 试图从本质上重置他的竞选活动并稳定他作为候选人的地位。

sentences.en: And I footnoted it.
sentences.zh: 而且我加了脚注。

sentences.en: And it does not go well.
sentences.zh: 结果并不顺利。

sentences.en: I was wrong, but I was not malevolent in any way.
sentences.zh: 我错了，但我绝无恶意。

sentences.en: He comes off defensive, defiant.
sentences.zh: 他显得防御性很强，充满挑衅。

sentences.en: That I did not intentionally move to mislead anybody.
sentences.zh: 我并没有故意误导任何人。

sentences.en: I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: And you can see him really start to see his initial case, which was so rooted in his own personal integrity, start to fall away.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到他最初的竞选基础——深深植根于他个人诚信——开始瓦解。

sentences.en: And when that falls away, there's not a whole lot left because there was not a really strong policy undergirding this campaign in the first place.
sentences.zh: 当基础瓦解时，剩下的就不多了，因为这场竞选本身就没有强有力的政策支撑。

sentences.en: By the fall, there is another thing happening.
sentences.zh: 到了秋天，又发生了一件事。

sentences.en: With great pleasure and deep respect for his extraordinary abilities, I today announce my intention to nominate United States Court of Appeals Judge Robert H.
sentences.zh: 我怀着极大的荣幸和对非凡能力的深切尊重，今天宣布我打算提名美国上诉法院法官罗伯特·H·

sentences.en: Bork.
sentences.zh: 博克。

sentences.en: Reagan nominates Robert H.
sentences.zh: 里根提名罗伯特·H·博克进入最高法院，民主党方面立即开始设法阻止这位极度保守的法官进入法院。

sentences.en: Bork to the Supreme Court, and there is immediately an effort on the Democratic side to figure out how they can best prevent a deeply conservative judge from reaching the court.
sentences.zh: 里根提名罗伯特·H·博克进入最高法院，民主党方面立即开始设法阻止这位极度保守的法官进入法院。

sentences.en: And Biden, who is the chairman of the Judiciary Committee in the Senate, is at the helm of that effort.
sentences.zh: 而时任参议院司法委员会主席的拜登，正是这一行动的掌舵人。

sentences.en: Those in favor of the Bork nomination will vote aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成博克提名的人请投赞成票。

sentences.en: Those opposed will vote no.
sentences.zh: 反对的人请投反对票。

sentences.en: The clerk will call the roll.
sentences.zh: 书记员请点名。

sentences.en: So his team gets together.
sentences.zh: 于是他的团队聚在一起。

sentences.en: Mr. Byrd.
sentences.zh: 伯德先生。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 反对。

sentences.zh: 梅岑巴赫先生。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 反对。

sentences.en: And one of his top advisors in the Senate essentially says to him.
sentences.zh: 他的一位高级参议院顾问对他说了这样一番话。

sentences.en: Mr. Deconcini.
sentences.zh: 德孔奇尼先生。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 反对。

sentences.en: If we lose the Bork fight at this point.
sentences.zh: 如果我们现在输掉了博克的这场仗。

sentences.en: Mr. Simon.
sentences.zh: 西蒙先生。

sentences.en: It'll be because of us.
sentences.zh: 那是因为我们自己的原因。

sentences.en: And if we win, it'll be in spite of us.
sentences.zh: 如果我们赢了，那也是尽管有我们（的阻碍）才赢的。

sentences.en: Mr. Thurman.
sentences.zh: 瑟蒙德先生。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: And that really resonates with him.
sentences.zh: 这番话深深触动了他。

sentences.en: He sees his day job as so essential, not just because he ostensibly cares about the constituents he serves,
sentences.zh: 他认为自己的本职工作至关重要，不仅是因为他表面上关心他所服务的选民，

sentences.en: but because he has been so ridiculed as a figure of less than considerable substance.
sentences.zh: 更是因为他一直被嘲笑为一个缺乏真才实学的人物。

sentences.en: A major Supreme Court hearing is quite the forum to push back against that idea.
sentences.zh: 一场重大的最高法院听证会正是反驳这种观点的绝佳平台。

sentences.en: Mr. Hatch.
sentences.zh: 哈奇先生。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: Mr. Simpson.
sentences.zh: 辛普森先生。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: So months before anybody even gets a chance to weigh in at the polls in Iowa and New Hampshire, Joe Biden is out.
sentences.zh: 所以，在任何人有机会在艾奥瓦州和新罕布什尔州的民调中发表意见之前，乔·拜登就退出了。

sentences.en: Mr. Grassley.
sentences.zh: 格拉斯利先生。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: He makes the decision himself.
sentences.zh: 他自己做出了决定。

sentences.en: He's going back to the Senate to finish the Bork fight.
sentences.zh: 他要回到参议院去完成博克这场仗。

sentences.en: Mr. Humphrey.
sentences.zh: 汉弗莱先生。

sentences.en: Aye.
sentences.zh: 赞成。

sentences.en: Mr. Biden.
sentences.zh: 拜登先生。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 反对。

sentences.en: And they win.
sentences.zh: 他们赢了。

sentences.en: The Robert Bork nomination ended today.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·博克的提名今天结束了。

sentences.en: The Senate voted by an overwhelming 58 to 42 margin.
sentences.zh: 参议院以58票对42票的压倒性优势进行了投票。

sentences.en: Bork is not confirmed, and Biden has a lot to do with that.
sentences.zh: 博克未获确认，而拜登在其中发挥了重要作用。

sentences.en: And it was a major victory for him.
sentences.zh: 这对他是场重大胜利。

sentences.en: So in order to protect his Senate career, he feels like he needs to end his bid for president.
sentences.zh: 为了保住他的参议员生涯，他觉得需要结束自己的总统竞选。

sentences.en: He feels like he needs to end his bid for president, and at that point, it is not at all clear that his bid for president would have gone particularly well anyway.
sentences.zh: 他觉得需要结束自己的总统竞选，而且在那时，他的竞选前景本来就不太明朗。

sentences.en: Mr. President, I'd like to make a few points here, if I may.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，如果可以的话，我想在这里提出几点意见。

sentences.en: He goes back to the Senate and really resolves to kind of put his head down and do the work of a senator
sentences.zh: 他回到参议院，下定决心埋头苦干，履行参议员的职责，

sentences.en: and aspires to the sort of legacy of some of the lions of the Senate that he has gotten to know fellow Democrats like a Ted Kennedy
sentences.zh: 并渴望像他所结识的泰德·肯尼迪等民主党同僚那样的参议院元老一样，留下某种政治遗产，

sentences.en: and also Republicans who he'd really grown close to over the years.
sentences.zh: 还有那些他多年来结下深厚友谊的共和党人。

sentences.en: So let me tell you, if your moral center is oil, I understand you.
sentences.zh: 所以让我告诉你，如果你的道德核心是石油，我理解你。

sentences.en: If your moral center is humanity, there is no comparing the restoration of Kuwait with the ending of genocide in Bosnia.
sentences.zh: 如果你的道德核心是人性，那么科威特的重建与波斯尼亚种族灭绝的终结是无法相提并论的。

sentences.en: He is really pushing this kind of muscular foreign policy idea that America should be a force for good in the world.
sentences.zh: 他确实在推动一种强有力的外交政策理念，即美国应该成为世界上一股向善的力量。

sentences.en: And what is the message we send to the world if we stand by and we say, we'll let it continue to happen here in this place, but it is not in our intereSt.
sentences.zh: 如果我们袖手旁观，说我们任由它在这里发生，但这不符合我们的利益，那我们向世界传递了什么信息？

sentences.en: He is pushing legislation around violence against women, pushing the crime bill in the mid-90s under President Clinton.
sentences.zh: 他推动了关于反对针对妇女暴力的立法，并在90年代中期克林顿总统任内推动了犯罪法案。

sentences.en: One of the things I want to do in addition to end the crime is end the political carnage that goes on when we talk about crime.
sentences.zh: 除了结束犯罪，我想做的另一件事是结束我们在谈论犯罪时所产生的政治杀戮。

sentences.en: He is seen as a particularly capable bipartisan figure.
sentences.zh: 他被视为一个非常有能力的跨党派人物。

sentences.en: Crime is not Democrat or Republican.
sentences.zh: 犯罪不分民主党还是共和党。

sentences.en: He talks about never questioning anybody's motive, maybe their politics, never their motive.
sentences.zh: 他说他从不质疑任何人的动机，也许会质疑他们的政治立场，但绝不质疑动机。

sentences.en: And he is seen as kind of an honest broker among Republicans, certainly in this period.
sentences.zh: 在这一时期，他确实被共和党人视为一个诚实的中间人。

sentences.en: And I think there's a consensus among Republicans in that.
sentences.zh: 我认为共和党人对此有共识。

sentences.en: Old barbed wire Republican conservatives, West want to hang them high.
sentences.zh: 那些老派的强硬共和党保守派，恨不得把他们吊死。

sentences.en: Even those folks are saying, hey, we got to deal with the root cause of this.
sentences.zh: 即使是这些人也在说，嘿，我们必须处理这个问题的根源。

sentences.en: Even if it brings him to disdain sometimes from the more liberal groups.
sentences.zh: 即使这有时会让他受到更自由派团体的蔑视。

sentences.en: And liberal Democrats who used to say, let's look at the sociological underpinnings of why this occurred.
sentences.zh: 而那些曾经说“让我们看看这背后社会学根源”的自由派民主党人，

sentences.en: And we have to, they're now saying, hey, look, we got to take back the streets.
sentences.zh: 现在也不得不说，嘿，听着，我们必须夺回街道的控制权。

sentences.en: We'll make that fight later.
sentences.zh: 那场仗我们以后再打。

sentences.en: But he really makes a particularly concerted effort in these years when he is not running for president
sentences.zh: 但在他不竞选总统的这些年里，他确实做出了特别专注的努力，

sentences.en: to bring the kind of heft to the day job that voters didn't necessarily see in 1988.
sentences.zh: 为他的本职工作注入了选民在1988年未必能看到的力度。

sentences.en: So when does Biden decide in the midst of this pretty successful engagement in the Senate that he's going to try to seek the presidency again?
sentences.zh: 那么，在参议院工作如此成功的情况下，拜登是在什么时候决定再次寻求总统职位的呢？

sentences.en: It's something he never lets go of fully.
sentences.zh: 这是他从未完全放弃的事情。

sentences.en: So he thinks about it in 2004 as George W.
sentences.zh: 所以他在2004年乔治·W·布什寻求连任时考虑过这件事，但最终决定放弃。

sentences.en: Bush is seeking re-election, decides against it in the end.
sentences.zh: 但等等，这才是他做出决定的时刻。

sentences.en: But oh, wait, is the time when he decides.
sentences.zh: 朋友们，今天我提交了必要的文件，成为美国总统候选人。

sentences.en: Friends, today I filed the necessary papers to become candidate for president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 朋友们，今天我提交了必要的文件，成为美国总统候选人。

sentences.en: He's ready for the second time.
sentences.zh: 他第二次准备好了。

sentences.en: And along with my wife, Jill, and my children, Beau, Hunter, and Ashley, we really look forward to being out there in the campaign trail with you and getting a chance to meet you.
sentences.zh: 我和我的妻子吉尔，还有我的孩子们博、亨特和阿什利，真的很期待能和你们一起走上竞选之路，并有机会见到你们。

sentences.en: And he's running as a very different candidate, obviously.
sentences.zh: 显然，他这次竞选的形象非常不同。

sentences.en: He's been in the Senate for more than 30 years.
sentences.zh: 他在参议院已经待了30多年了。

sentences.en: It's his sixth term.
sentences.zh: 这是他的第六个任期。

sentences.en: And he brings with that a set of experiences he didn't have in 1988.
sentences.zh: 他带来了1988年时所不具备的一系列经验。

sentences.en: I've spent the last four years traveling back and forth to Iraq, meeting with our soldiers, our generals, and our diplomats,
sentences.zh: 过去四年里，我往返于伊拉克，会见我们的士兵、将军和外交官，

sentences.en: and trying my level best to convince the president to change course.
sentences.zh: 尽我所能说服总统改变方针。

sentences.en: This is a moment of unpopular wars going on in the country.
sentences.zh: 这是一个国家正经历不受欢迎战争的时刻。

sentences.en: And he's somebody, according to his pitch, who really understands those challenges because of the work that he's done in the Senate since his last campaign.
sentences.zh: 根据他的竞选说辞，他是一个真正理解这些挑战的人，因为他在上次竞选后在参议院所做的工作。

sentences.en: The next president of the United States is going to have to be prepared to immediately step in and act without hesitation to end our involvement in Iraq
sentences.zh: 下一任美国总统必须准备好立即介入，毫不犹豫地采取行动，结束我们对伊拉克的参与，

sentences.en: without further destabilizing the Middle East and the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 同时不再进一步破坏中东和世界其他地区的稳定。

sentences.en: But as it turns out, that kind of experience did not necessarily resonate widely with voters for a whole host of reasons.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，由于种种原因，这种经验并不一定能引起选民的广泛共鸣。

sentences.en: For one, he is a figure who is running up against a historic moment in this Democratic primary.
sentences.zh: 首先，他面对的是这次民主党初选中的一个历史性时刻。

sentences.en: Generations of Americans have responded with a simple creed.
sentences.zh: 几代美国人都以一个简单的信条作为回应。

sentences.en: Barack Obama is running.
sentences.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马正在参选。

sentences.en: That sums up the spirit of a people.
sentences.zh: 这概括了一个民族的精神。

sentences.en: Yes, we can.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们能。

sentences.en: Yes, we can.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们能。

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton is running.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿正在参选。

sentences.en: The question isn't whether we can keep America's promise.
sentences.zh: 问题不在于我们能否信守美国的承诺。

sentences.en: It's whether we will keep America's promise.
sentences.zh: 而在于我们是否会信守美国的承诺。

sentences.en: And despite the relative inexperience in the Senate as his colleagues,
sentences.zh: 尽管他在参议院的资历与同事相比相对较浅，

sentences.en: the non-historic nature of the Biden campaign as a white man in his 60s really feels out of step with the times when set against these dynamic and compelling
sentences.zh: 但作为一个60多岁的白人，拜登竞选活动的非历史性特质，在这些充满活力、引人注目，

sentences.en: and particularly history-making candidates against him.
sentences.zh: 尤其是创造历史的竞争对手面前，确实显得与时代脱节。

sentences.en: At the same time, we see flashes of the 88 campaign Biden come to the fore very early in this race.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们很早就在这场竞选中看到了88年竞选时拜登的影子。

sentences.en: I mean, you've got the first sort of mainstream African-American
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你有了第一个主流的非裔美国人，

sentences.en: who is articulate and bright and clean and nice-looking guy.
sentences.zh: 他口齿伶俐、聪明、干净、长相帅气。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a storybook, man.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那简直像童话故事一样，伙计。

sentences.en: He also just had a lot of these moments.
sentences.zh: 他也确实有过很多这样的时刻。

sentences.en: I spent last summer going through the black sections of my town holding rallies in parks trying to get black men to understand it's not unmanly to wear a condom,
sentences.zh: 去年夏天我花时间走访了镇上的黑人社区，在公园里举行集会，试图让黑人男性明白戴避孕套并不是不男人，

sentences.en: getting women to understand they can say no, getting people in the position where testing matters.
sentences.zh: 让女性明白她们可以拒绝，让人们意识到检测的重要性。

sentences.en: These moments of sounding out of touch in kind of a cringeworthy way, sort of an uncle at a family gathering saying something that he probably shouldn't.
sentences.zh: 这些听起来有些脱节且令人尴尬的时刻，就像家庭聚会上一个叔叔说了些他不该说的话。

sentences.en: I got tested for AIDS.
sentences.zh: 我做了艾滋病检测。

sentences.en: I know Barack got tested for AIDS.
sentences.zh: 我知道贝拉克也做了艾滋病检测。

sentences.en: There's no shame in being tested for AIDS.
sentences.zh: 做艾滋病检测没什么可羞耻的。

sentences.en: It's an important thing because the fact of the matter is in the community, in the communities engaged in denial.
sentences.zh: 这很重要，因为事实是，在这个社区里，人们都在逃避现实。

sentences.en: And on the policy side, quite frankly, on the most important foreign policy issue of the day, despite his experience in the Senate that he touted,
sentences.zh: 而在政策方面，坦率地说，在当今最重要的外交政策问题上，尽管他吹嘘自己在参议院有经验，

sentences.en: he's on the opposite side of Barack Obama.
sentences.zh: 他却站在了贝拉克·奥巴马的对立面。

sentences.en: He voted for the Iraq war.
sentences.zh: 他投票支持了伊拉克战争。

sentences.en: Obama did not.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马没有。

sentences.en: And the point that Barack Obama made throughout is, I may not have the experience on paper, but I do have the wisdom to avoid a blunder such as that.
sentences.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马始终强调的一点是，我可能在纸面上没有经验，但我有智慧去避免那样的失误。

sentences.en: So at just the moment when Biden thought that he had proven he was the workhorse and the steady hand and the experienced kind of gray beard of the Senate,
sentences.zh: 所以，就在拜登以为自己已经证明了自己是参议院的实干家、稳健的操盘手和经验丰富的元老时，

sentences.en: that turned out to be the wrong kind of set of experiences for the Democratic electorate.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，对于民主党选民来说，这并不是他们想要的经验。

sentences.en: It just did not fit the moment.
sentences.zh: 这根本不符合当时的时代需求。

sentences.en: And there was really never a moment in that campaign when he felt like a particularly serious threat to take the nomination.
sentences.zh: 在那场竞选中，他从未真正被视为获得提名的严重威胁。

sentences.en: The voters of Iowa render their verdicts and he drops out almost immediately thereafter.
sentences.zh: 艾奥瓦州的选民做出了裁决，此后不久他就退出了。

sentences.en: But unlike 88, he really doesn't embarrass himself either in the end.
sentences.zh: 但与88年不同的是，他最终并没有让自己出丑。

sentences.en: He is seen as a sort of affable, knowledgeable peer among his rivals.
sentences.zh: 他被视为竞争对手中和蔼可亲、知识渊博的同僚。

sentences.en: But he does have to leave the race.
sentences.zh: 但他确实不得不退出竞选。

sentences.en: So here we have another failed presidential bid.
sentences.zh: 所以我们又看到了一次失败的总统竞选。

sentences.en: And for the second time, Biden doesn't really get all that far in these Democratic primaries.
sentences.zh: 这是拜登第二次在民主党初选中没能走得太远。

sentences.en: And no, two campaigns, zero states won.
sentences.zh: 没错，两次竞选，零个州获胜。

sentences.en: But what he does get out of this race is...
sentences.zh: 但他从这次竞选中得到的是……

sentences.en: For months, I've searched for a leader to finish this journey alongside me.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，我一直在寻找一位能与我共同完成这段旅程的领导者。

sentences.en: Really earning the respect of the eventual nominee, Barack Obama.
sentences.zh: 他真正赢得了最终提名人贝拉克·奥巴马的尊重。

sentences.en: Today, I have come back to Springfield to tell you that I found that leader.
sentences.zh: 今天，我回到斯普林菲尔德告诉你们，我找到了那位领导者。

sentences.en: So when the time comes to pick a running mate...
sentences.zh: 所以当需要选择竞选搭档时……

sentences.en: A man with a distinguished record.
sentences.zh: 一位有着杰出记录的人。

sentences.en: A man with fundamental decency.
sentences.zh: 一位有着基本正派品质的人。

sentences.en: And that man is Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 那个人就是乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Barack Obama chooses Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马选择了乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Biden at this point is not seen as particularly likely to seek the presidency again.
sentences.zh: 此时的拜登并不被认为很有可能再次寻求总统职位。

sentences.en: He's obviously in his 60s.
sentences.zh: 他显然已经60多岁了。

sentences.en: He's run twice and failed.
sentences.zh: 他已经竞选过两次且都失败了。

sentences.en: But we now know there's a conversation that the two of them have as he's offering Biden the running mate slot.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在知道，在奥巴马向拜登提供竞选搭档职位时，他们有过一次谈话。

sentences.en: And Obama says to him, this is in Biden's telling,
sentences.zh: 据拜登讲述，奥巴马对他说：

sentences.en: I hope you see this as the capstone to your career.
sentences.zh: 我希望你把这看作是你职业生涯的巅峰。

sentences.en: And Biden says back to him, and not the tombstone.
sentences.zh: 拜登回答说：而不是墓碑。

sentences.en: But that is set aside for the moment.
sentences.zh: 但那暂时被搁置了。

sentences.en: He goes off into the Obama campaign.
sentences.zh: 他投身于奥巴马的竞选活动中。

sentences.en: And of course, Obama and Biden win that election.
sentences.zh: 当然，奥巴马和拜登赢得了那场选举。

sentences.en: I want to thank my partner in this journey.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢我这段旅程中的伙伴。

sentences.en: A man who campaigned from his heart and spoke for the men and women he grew up with on the streets of Scranton.
sentences.zh: 一个全心全意竞选，并为他在斯克兰顿街头一起长大的男男女女代言的人。

sentences.en: The vice president-elect of the United States, Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 美国当选副总统，乔·拜登。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡，你愿意试试吗？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在机会来了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序，即可免费使用一个月。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 这一个月，你可以突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》的订阅用户每天都能读到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载这款应用，获取30天的免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: So just as after 1988, when Biden kind of threw himself into the role of being a senator, after he loses that 08 race,
sentences.zh: 就像1988年之后，拜登全身心地投入到参议员的角色中一样，在输掉2008年的竞选后，

sentences.en: he really pours himself into the vice presidency in this case.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他真正地将自己倾注到了副总统的职位上。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: He sees himself as the sort of ultimate lieutenant for the first black president and takes very seriously the idea that they are full partners.
sentences.zh: 他将自己视为首位黑人总统的终极副手，并非常认真地对待他们作为全面合作伙伴的理念。

sentences.en: He wants to be the last person who Obama talks to before making a major decision.
sentences.zh: 他希望成为奥巴马在做出重大决策前交谈的最后一个人。

sentences.en: He wants to be in the room where those tough calls are happening.
sentences.zh: 他希望身处那些艰难决策的现场。

sentences.en: And I do think there is a parallel to that period in his Senate life between his presidential runs.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为，这与他参议员生涯中两次竞选总统之间的那段时期有相似之处。

sentences.en: He definitely both absorbs this idea that he should be doing the job he has and not the job that he might aspire to, and seems to believe it.
sentences.zh: 他无疑既接受了“应该做好本职工作，而不是去想那些可能渴望的职位”这一理念，而且似乎也对此深信不疑。

sentences.en: And there is certainly a belief among those in the Obama White House that he is not necessarily giving up on those ambitions down the line,
sentences.zh: 奥巴马白宫内部确实有人相信，他并没有完全放弃未来竞选总统的野心，

sentences.en: but he is not seen as somebody positioning himself for Iran either.
sentences.zh: 但人们也不认为他是在为未来做铺垫。

sentences.en: And is that really the case, Matt?
sentences.zh: 马特，事实真的如此吗？

sentences.en: Because my sense is that by the time Obama is ready to leave office, that ember that is Joe Biden's perpetual desire to seek the presidency is glowing pretty brightly.
sentences.zh: 因为我的感觉是，当奥巴马即将离任时，乔·拜登内心那种对总统宝座永恒的渴望之火，已经烧得非常旺了。

sentences.en: It is, and it probably never went out.
sentences.zh: 确实，而且这团火可能从未熄灭过。

sentences.en: You don't think about such things in grade school and relinquish them in your 70s.
sentences.zh: 你不会在小学时有这样的想法，到了70多岁就放弃了。

sentences.en: But a couple of things happen late in Obama's second term.
sentences.zh: 但在奥巴马的第二个任期末，发生了一些事情。

sentences.en: One of them is political.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是政治上的。

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton's running for president again.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿再次竞选总统。

sentences.en: She is effectively clearing the field, it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 看起来，她实际上正在扫清竞选道路上的障碍。

sentences.en: A lot of the Obama operation is already lining up behind her.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马团队的许多人已经开始支持她了。

sentences.en: Barack Obama makes clear that he sees her as a pretty suitable heir, potentially.
sentences.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马明确表示，他认为她可能是一个相当合适的继任者。

sentences.en: And then tragically, there is the death of Beau Biden,
sentences.zh: 然后，悲剧发生了，博·拜登去世了，

sentences.en: Joe's eldest son, his political heir to the would-be Biden dynasty in Delaware.
sentences.zh: 他是乔的长子，也是特拉华州拜登家族政治王朝的潜在继承人。

sentences.en: He was the state attorney general.
sentences.zh: 他曾担任该州的司法部长。

sentences.en: And it was wrenching.
sentences.zh: 那真是令人心碎。

sentences.en: This was someone who had already been left to grieve so publicly with such raw emotion early in his Senate life.
sentences.zh: 这已经是他在参议员生涯早期，第二次不得不如此公开地承受那种撕心裂肺的悲痛了。

sentences.en: And for the second time, he is burying a child.
sentences.zh: 这是他第二次白发人送黑人。

sentences.en: So this was just a particularly searing moment for all those who know and love Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 所以，对于所有了解并爱戴乔·拜登的人来说，这是一个格外痛苦的时刻。

sentences.en: And through some combination of the rawness of that morning
sentences.zh: 由于那种丧子之痛的冲击，

sentences.en: and how far down the road the Clinton campaign had already gotten, he opts not to run.
sentences.zh: 再加上克林顿的竞选活动已经推进了很远，他最终选择不参选。

sentences.en: Good morning, folks.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: Please, please sit down.
sentences.zh: 请坐，请坐。

sentences.en: He stands in the Rose Garden beside President Obama.
sentences.zh: 他站在玫瑰园里，陪在奥巴马总统身边。

sentences.en: And there's a moment in the beginning of that press conference.
sentences.zh: 在那场新闻发布会的开头有一个瞬间。

sentences.en: And he says...
sentences.zh: 他说……

sentences.en: Mr. President, thank you for lending me the Rose Garden for a minute.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，谢谢你借我玫瑰园用一分钟。

sentences.en: It's a pretty nice place.
sentences.zh: 这地方真不错。

sentences.en: And there is this sense watching that, that it was not a place that Joe Biden would have to himself down the line, that this was probably his last window to run.
sentences.zh: 看着那一幕，人们有一种感觉：这不再是乔·拜登未来能独自拥有的地方了，这很可能是他最后一次参选的机会。

sentences.en: As my family and I have worked through the grieving process,
sentences.zh: 正如我和我的家人在经历悲伤的过程时所说的那样，

sentences.en: I've said all along what I've said time and again to others, that it may very well be that that process,
sentences.zh: 我一直以来都在对别人说，也反复说过，很有可能这个过程，

sentences.en: by the time we get through it,
sentences.zh: 等我们走出来的时候，

sentences.en: closes the window on mounting a realistic campaign for a president, that it might close.
sentences.zh: 可能已经关闭了发起一场现实的总统竞选的窗口，它可能已经关闭了。

sentences.en: I've concluded it has closed.
sentences.zh: 我得出的结论是，它已经关闭了。

sentences.en: It was a poignant reminder of all that he had been through prior and how he had come to be seen as this kind of avatar of trauma and resilience
sentences.zh: 这令人心酸地提醒了人们他之前所经历的一切，以及他是如何被视为这种创伤与韧性的化身，

sentences.en: and how central that was to his public arc throughout his career.
sentences.zh: 以及这在他整个职业生涯的公众形象中占据了多么核心的地位。

sentences.en: And to have this bookend his time as vice president was something that to Democrats and Republicans just felt unfair.
sentences.zh: 而让这件事成为他副总统任期的终点，对于民主党人和共和党人来说，都感到太不公平了。

sentences.en: And I remember, Matt, thinking after watching that news conference that this was his last chance to run for president.
sentences.zh: 马特，我记得看完那场新闻发布会后，我心想这是他最后一次竞选总统的机会了。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people thought that.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人都这么认为。

sentences.en: But it turned out that his presidential aspirations did not end in the Rose Garden that day.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，他的总统梦并没有在那天的玫瑰园画上句号。

sentences.en: He ran again in 2020.
sentences.zh: 他在2020年再次参选。

sentences.en: And after a rollercoaster campaign in which he was up and he was down, and for a moment it looked like he was almost written off, he prevails.
sentences.zh: 在经历了一场跌宕起伏的竞选后，他曾处于高潮，也曾陷入低谷，一度看起来几乎被淘汰出局，但他最终胜出了。

sentences.en: And just a couple of nights ago, he is formally designated the Democratic Party's nominee for president.
sentences.zh: 就在几天前，他正式被提名为民主党总统候选人。

sentences.en: And so I'm curious in your mind what he had going for him in 2020 that he didn't have in those previous two runs.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，在你看来，他在2020年拥有什么，而他在前两次竞选中却没有？

sentences.en: Well, in some ways it's a culmination of those runs and all that he had experienced in the time since.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在某种程度上，这是他历次竞选以及此后所有经历的结晶。

sentences.en: He is fusing the kind of personal integrity argument from his 88 campaign, his own character, his own decency, and the experience case that he's making an 08,
sentences.zh: 他融合了88年竞选中那种个人诚信的论点，即他个人的品格和正直，以及他在08年提出的经验论点，

sentences.en: that he is somebody who has been there, has seen it, and knows what to do.
sentences.zh: 即他是一个身经百战、见多识广、知道该怎么做的人。

sentences.en: And it turns out that that combination
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这种结合

sentences.en: becomes pretty compelling in 2020.
sentences.zh: 在2020年变得非常有说服力。

sentences.en: He is somebody who, through the context of this moment, found a rationale.
sentences.zh: 他是一个通过当下的背景，找到了竞选理由的人。

sentences.en: His advisors would say he met the moment.
sentences.zh: 他的顾问会说他顺应了时代。

sentences.en: In some ways, the moment dictated it.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，是时代造就了他。

sentences.en: He ran a campaign in the primary premised, not particularly on policy or ideology, but on the idea that the country is better than this and that this president has to be defeated.
sentences.zh: 他在初选中的竞选活动并不是基于政策或意识形态，而是基于这样一个理念：国家比现在更好，必须击败这位总统。

sentences.en: My fellow Americans, there are moments in our history so grim, so heart-rending, that there are forever fixed in each of our hearts
sentences.zh: 我的美国同胞们，在我们历史上有这样一些时刻，如此严峻，如此令人心碎，以至于永远铭刻在我们每个人的心中，

sentences.en: a shared grief.
sentences.zh: 那是一种共同的悲伤。

sentences.en: And his campaign argument in some ways hinges almost exclusively on this idea that he is a figure of unique perspective.
sentences.zh: 他的竞选论点在某种程度上几乎完全取决于他是一个具有独特视角的人物这一理念。

sentences.en: Today is one of those moments.
sentences.zh: 今天就是这样的时刻之一。

sentences.en: 100,000 lives have now been lost to this virus.
sentences.zh: 现在已经有10万人因这种病毒而失去了生命。

sentences.en: In this moment of a pandemic, of a reckoning over racial justice, sort of overlapping crises and traumas.
sentences.zh: 在这个大流行病、种族正义清算的时刻，各种危机和创伤交织在一起。

sentences.en: I think I know what you're feeling.
sentences.zh: 我想我知道你们现在的感受。

sentences.en: You feel like you're being sucked into a black hole in the middle of your cheSt.
sentences.zh: 你感觉自己就像被吸进了胸口中间的一个黑洞。

sentences.en: It's suffocating.
sentences.zh: 令人窒息。

sentences.en: He is holding himself out as somebody who knows how to overcome such things.
sentences.zh: 他把自己塑造成一个知道如何克服这些困难的人。

sentences.en: Because he has.
sentences.zh: 因为他经历过。

sentences.en: This nation grieves with you.
sentences.zh: 这个国家与你们一同哀悼。

sentences.en: Take some solace from the fact.
sentences.zh: 从这个事实中得到一些慰藉吧。

sentences.en: We all grieve with you.
sentences.zh: 我们都与你们一同哀悼。

sentences.en: It's not as if his biography wasn't compelling in past races, but it's so much more resonant in a moment of collective grief in the country and of such tremendous trauma
sentences.zh: 并不是说他的生平在过去的竞选中没有吸引力，但在国家集体悲伤和人们日常生活中遭受巨大创伤的时刻，它显得更加引起共鸣，

sentences.en: and upheaval in people's daily lives.
sentences.zh: 也更加动荡。

sentences.en: But at the same time...
sentences.zh: 但与此同时……

sentences.en: You have a problem figuring out whether you're for me or Trump and you ain't black.
sentences.zh: 如果你在搞不清楚是支持我还是支持特朗普，那你就不是黑人。

sentences.en: He is still the Joe Biden that audiences have seen and occasionally chafed at seeing over the years.
sentences.zh: 他依然是多年来观众所见到的那个乔·拜登，有时甚至让人感到不耐烦。

sentences.en: He is prone to gaffes.
sentences.zh: 他容易失言。

sentences.en: He had a handful of interactions with voters on the trail during the primary.
sentences.zh: 在初选期间，他与选民有过几次互动。

sentences.en: You're a damn liar, man.
sentences.zh: 你这个该死的骗子，伙计。

sentences.en: That's not true.
sentences.zh: 那不是真的。

sentences.en: And no one has ever said that.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人那么说过。

sentences.en: No one has heard of that.
sentences.zh: 没人听说过那个。

sentences.en: That I think his campaign instantly regretted.
sentences.zh: 我想他的竞选团队立刻就后悔了。

sentences.en: Sort of confrontational, evocative of that I have a higher IQ than you do moment from 88.
sentences.zh: 这有点对抗性，让人想起88年那个“我的智商比你高”的时刻。

sentences.en: You said I set up my son to work in an oil company.
sentences.zh: 你说我安排我儿子去石油公司工作。

sentences.en: You know what you said?
sentences.zh: 你知道你说了什么吗？

sentences.en: Get your words straight, Jack.
sentences.zh: 把话说清楚点，杰克。

sentences.en: He's liable to get carried away in front of a crowd, to exaggerate, to misstate something on the debate stage.
sentences.zh: 他很容易在人群面前得意忘形，夸大其词，或者在辩论台上说错话。

sentences.en: There's no question that those weaknesses persiSt.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，这些弱点依然存在。

sentences.en: And I can get things done.
sentences.zh: 我能把事情办成。

sentences.en: That's why I'm running.
sentences.zh: 这就是我参选的原因。

sentences.en: And you want to check my shape on it.
sentences.zh: 你想检查一下我的身体状况吗？

sentences.en: Let's do push-ups together, man.
sentences.zh: 我们一起做俯卧撑吧，伙计。

sentences.en: Let's do, let's run.
sentences.zh: 我们来做，我们来跑。

sentences.en: Let's do whatever you want to do.
sentences.zh: 我们做任何你想做的事。

sentences.en: So in his first run in 88, he talked about how he saw presidential history in cycles.
sentences.zh: 所以在他88年的第一次竞选中，他谈到了他是如何看待总统历史的周期性的。

sentences.en: You had these kind of bursts of progress and upheaval followed by these moments of correction where voters wanted to choose a candidate who could let the country catch its breath.
sentences.zh: 你会经历这种进步和动荡的爆发，随后是选民想要选择一个能让国家喘口气的候选人的修正时刻。

sentences.en: And the implication then was that he was that candidate, that he was the generational change, the burst of progress.
sentences.zh: 当时的暗示是他就是那个候选人，他是代际变革，是进步的爆发。

sentences.en: And the implication now is that he is the figure who can let America catch its breath.
sentences.zh: 而现在的暗示是他是一个能让美国喘口气的人物。

sentences.en: And there is such a conspicuous passage of time in that.
sentences.zh: 这其中有着极其明显的时间流逝感。

sentences.en: He is not running on generational change as a 77-year-old man in the way that he was 32 years ago.
sentences.zh: 作为一个77岁的老人，他不再像32年前那样以代际变革为口号进行竞选。

sentences.en: And that passage of time is evident.
sentences.zh: 这种时间的流逝显而易见。

sentences.en: You can hear it in his speeches.
sentences.zh: 你可以在他的演讲中听到。

sentences.en: You can see it in his public appearances.
sentences.zh: 你可以在他的公开露面中看到。

sentences.en: He has been through a lot.
sentences.zh: 他经历了很多。

sentences.en: He has done a lot.
sentences.zh: 他做了很多。

sentences.en: He has earned that agedness at this stage of his career.
sentences.zh: 在他职业生涯的这个阶段，他赢得了这种老成。

sentences.en: Matt, I wonder how it will feel for Joe Biden tonight after all these failed attempts, after all of his personal tragedy, to finally have this moment arrive some 30 years
sentences.zh: 马特，我想知道乔·拜登今晚会有什么感觉，在经历了所有这些失败的尝试，经历了所有的个人悲剧之后，终于在30年后迎来了这一刻，

sentences.en: after he first tries for it.
sentences.zh: 在他第一次尝试竞选之后。

sentences.en: And I'm sure 30 years of thinking about trying for it again.
sentences.zh: 我相信他这30年来一直在思考再次尝试的事。

sentences.en: He will walk out, I guess, to a podium.
sentences.zh: 我想他会走到讲台前。

sentences.en: This is virtual.
sentences.zh: 这是虚拟的。

sentences.en: It will be weird.
sentences.zh: 这会很奇怪。

sentences.en: And he will accept at last the Democratic Party's nomination for president.
sentences.zh: 他终于将接受民主党的总统候选人提名。

sentences.en: How is that going to feel for him?
sentences.zh: 他会有什么感觉？

sentences.en: I think like so much in his political career, it'll be bittersweet.
sentences.zh: 我想就像他政治生涯中的许多事情一样，这将是苦乐参半的。

sentences.en: I mean, think about the scene.
sentences.zh: 我是说，想想那个场景。

sentences.en: He will not be in an arena in Milwaukee.
sentences.zh: 他不会在密尔沃基的竞技场里。

sentences.en: He will be at a remote location in Wilmington.
sentences.zh: 他将在威尔明顿的一个远程地点。

sentences.en: He will not have a crowd of people chanting his name, no balloons, no We Love Joe.
sentences.zh: 他不会有成群结队高呼他名字的人，没有气球，没有“我们爱乔”的欢呼声。

sentences.en: And I think that reflects the moment, but is also such a spectacular come down from the vision of this that he might have had.
sentences.zh: 我认为这反映了当下的时刻，但与他可能想象的愿景相比，也是一种巨大的落差。

sentences.en: He's been thinking about the presidency for decade after decade.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，他一直在思考总统职位的问题。

sentences.en: Today, I announce my candidacy for president of the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 今天，我宣布竞选美利坚合众国总统。

sentences.en: And so much of it won't look like he expected it to in this moment of triumph.
sentences.zh: 在这个胜利的时刻，很多事情看起来都不会像他预期的那样。

sentences.en: God bless you and thank you.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你们，谢谢。

sentences.en: Both superficially because of the convention set up and substantially most powerfully for him because Beau Biden won't be there.
